exact_statement: For f_n=1-2*1_{x=0}, n>=2, every adaptive physical singleton tree querying nonconstant nodes to constant leaves has one active k-bit node of probability 2^(k-n), d_k=2^(1-k). Let Delta_n=TC(f_n), L=log2(e), d=d_n, I_n=nd, and G_n,C_n,J_n be accumulated Gamma, occupancy mutual information and child-mixture JS. Then Delta_n+J_n=G_n+C_n and G_n=n h2(d)-sum_{k=1}^n 2^(k-n)h2(d_k). With A_n=n(n-1)/2, A_n d<=G_n<=(A_n+2L)d and [2(n-1)-1]d<=J_n<=[2(n-1)+4L-1]d. Thus G_n/Delta_n->1/2, C_n/Delta_n->1/2, J_n/Delta_n->0. Under the actual common coherent reveal kernel applied to both source and product reference, accumulated Bayes-outcome KL O_n satisfies 0<=O_n<=8Ld and accumulated signed reset R_n=O_n+J_n-G_n has R_n/Delta_n->-1/2. In particular G_n/I_n>=(n-1)/2 for every full singleton coordinate order; no universal O(I) aggregate Gamma payment exists on these trees.
